title: In this town, everyone has a price over their head
format: narrative what-if (Larptuber 'In this town' one-rule world; fiction lane test #1)

hook.narration: In this town, the number over your head is the bounty on your life.

visual.v1: dusk town square wide; every NPC carries a floating amber price tag ($10,000 / $50,000 / $2,500); the hero stands dead-center with a gray $0 tag; title 'IN THIS TOWN,' / 'EVERYONE HAS A PRICE' on frame-0; warm windows, long shadows

scenes.narration: My number said zero. Everyone laughed.

visual.v1: closer on the hero; two-three NPCs point and double over laughing; hero's face 100% neutral; the $0 tag pulses once; big gray $0 stamp

scenes.narration: Until the Red Purge sirens blared.

visual.v1: sky flips to night; a red wash sweeps left-to-right; siren rings ripple out from the town hall; NPCs freeze mid-laugh

scenes.narration: And every steel door in town slammed shut.

visual.v1: a row of four steel doors slams in sequence (dust puffs, shudder frames); red light strobes; the street empties

scenes.narration: So I ran door to door, screaming.

visual.v1: hero sprints down the red-lit street (motion lines, coat trail), fists on doors

scenes.narration: Please — the monsters are right behind me. My face never moved.

visual.v1: the deadpan close-up: hero hammers a door, mouth open in a scream-shape, but the face is stone neutral; quote stamp 'THE MONSTERS ARE RIGHT BEHIND ME'; this frame is the rewatch bait

scenes.narration: Worth zero means harmless. Armed neighbors stepped out to enjoy the show.

visual.v1: the mansion row: bolts slide, four steel doors open, armed silhouettes (bat, pipe, pitchfork) step out smirking; stamp '$0 = HARMLESS'

scenes.narration: The last door clicked open. I stopped running.

visual.v1: mid-street: hero skids to a stop, head turns slowly back over the shoulder; the last mansion door swings; a click ring

scenes.narration: And peeled the zero off my head.

visual.v1: THE PEEL (money shot): close on the hero's hand reaching above the head, gripping the $0 sticker, peeling it up (bend, rotate, fall); a glass-shatter flash
THE REVEAL: $999,999,999 blazes blood-red above the hero, red light floods the street (bed_peak); every NPC tag flips red

scenes.narration: The monsters were never hunting me. They were here to collect.

visual.v1: shadow monsters drop from the rooftops (three-four tall ink giants, ember eyes, landing rings); the armed neighbors freeze mid-smirk

scenes.narration: Monsters can't break steel doors. They just needed someone dumb enough to beg them open.

visual.v1: hero walks calm through the open mansion door; the steel door swings shut, bolt slams (clank); through the window: shadows swarm the street; smash cut to black on the last word — hard loop, no CTA

sources.premise: Boss day-022 brief 'The Zero-Dollar Bait' (Fang Yuan archetype: weaponized helplessness + town-wide Trojan Horse lure; double twist: fake $0 -> $999,999,999; monsters collect, never hunt).
sources.format_research: research/larpniverse-sweep-2026-11-18.md — measured intown specs applied: premise+exact rule in sentence one; kicker sentences ('My face never moved.'); escalation ladder; 4-6-word twist ('They were here to collect.'); rule re-read closer; hard cut, no CTA; 232 WPM inside the measured 229-285 band.
